_description: Schema contract for the Indian agriculture knowledge skeleton. Two record types: entities and relations. All facts are deterministic — each entity/relation carries a source reference registered in sources.md. No LLM-generated facts.

field_specs.id: Unique dotted id, e.g. soil.black_soil. URI-like so KG conversion is trivial.
field_specs.name: Canonical English name.
field_specs.aliases: Alternate names / local names (English only for now). May include AGROVOC prefLabels via agrovocId.
field_specs.domain: One of the domain roots defined below.
field_specs.type: Entity type from the type taxonomy below.
field_specs.relations: Array of relation objects: {predicate, object, source?}.
field_specs.notes: Free-text: coverage state, gap notes, TODO markers.
field_specs.agrovocId: Optional AGROVOC concept URI for cross-linking to agrovoc_entities_filtered.json.

predicates.part_of: part of a larger entity (e.g. domain part_of agriculture)
predicates.found_in: located/found in a location (soil in states)
predicates.controlled_by: controlled by a substance/measure (pest controlled_by pesticide)
predicates.requires: requires a resource (crop requires soil type)
predicates.grown_in_state: crop grown in a state (convenience of grown_in)

domains.location: Anchor: India -> states/UTs -> districts + agro-climatic zones + regions.
domains.soil: Soil types of India, characteristics, distribution, suitability.
domains.crops: All crops: cereals, millets, pulses, oilseeds, fibres, sugar, horticulture, spices, plantation, fodder; seasons, varieties, agronomy.
domains.livestock: Cattle, buffalo, goat, sheep, pig, poultry, camel, yak, mithun; breeds (NBAGR), dairy, diseases.
domains.pesticides: Registered pesticides (CIB&RC), classes, banned/restricted list, biopesticides.
domains.fertilizers: Chemical fertilizers, biofertilizers, manures, NPK norms.
domains.organic: Organic farming, NPOP/PGS-India certification, organic states, inputs, methods.
domains.water: Irrigation systems, water resources, river basins, groundwater.
domains.weather: Monsoon, seasons, agro-climatic zones, climate of India.
domains.seeds: Seed types, hybrid/variety lists, certification, seed corps.
domains.machinery: Farm machinery and implements used in India.
domains.plant_protection: Pests, diseases, weeds affecting Indian crops.
domains.fisheries: Marine, inland, aquaculture species and producing states.
domains.post_harvest: Storage, cold chain, processing, grading, losses.
domains.market: Mandis, APMC, MSP, e-NAM, exports, insurance.
domains.schemes: Government schemes and agricultural institutions (ICAR, SAUs, KVKs).
domains.forestry: Forests, timber, non-timber forest products, agroforestry.

conventions.name_language: English only (v1); Hindi/local names allowed in aliases only
conventions.location_refs: Location relations MUST resolve to ids in data/locations/*.json
conventions.source_refs: Every entity and every relation MUST carry a source id present in sources.md
conventions.gap_marking: Uncollected leaf-level data is marked in notes with TODO + expected count, never fabricated
conventions.kg_ready: KG conversion = emit (id, predicate, object) for every relation; entities become nodes
